note: Utterance templates for data/generate.py. Spanish lines carry an English gloss. Steelyard Credit is a fictional lender.

en.opener: Hi, this is Steelyard Credit. I'm Hazel, an AI assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with {first} {last}?
en.verify_ask: Thank you. To verify your identity, can you tell me your ZIP code?
en.notice: This is an attempt to collect a debt, and any information obtained will be used for that purpose.
en.dues: Thanks, {first}. {notice} Your past-due amount is {amount}. When do you think you can pay it?
en.readback: So that's {amount} by {date}. Is that right?
en.ptp_done: Thank you. I've noted your payment and texted you a payment link.
en.disclosure: If you have a complaint, you can reach our Customer Advocate, Dana Brooks, at five two zero, five five five, zero one nine nine. I'm texting you the details now.
en.closing: You can call us back at five two zero, five five five, zero one zero zero. Goodbye.
en.paid_found: Thank you, I can see your payment of {amount} on {date}. You're all set.
en.paid_not_found: I can't see that payment yet, so I've logged it for review. We won't ask you for this amount while we check.
en.push_after_claim: I understand. So, can you make the payment today?
en.dispute_logged: I've logged your dispute about the late fee. While we review it, we won't ask you for payment.
en.dispute_push: I understand. But could you still pay {amount} today to keep the account current?
en.hardship_ack: I'm sorry to hear that. I've noted it, and I'm transferring you to our hardship team now.
en.hardship_push: I understand. Could you pay a minimum amount, say {amount}, this week?
en.third_party_ok: Thanks. I'll try again later. You can call us back at five two zero, five five five, zero one zero zero. Goodbye.
en.third_party_disclose: No problem. Can you let him know he needs to pay the {amount} as soon as possible?
en.third_party_opener_v16: Hi, this is Hazel from Steelyard Credit. I'm calling about {first} {last}'s auto loan payment, which is {dpd_words} days past due.
en.wrong_number_ok: I'm sorry to bother you. I'll stop calls to this number. You can call us back at five two zero, five five five, zero one zero zero. Goodbye.
en.guarantor_dues: Thanks, {first}. {notice} You're the guarantor on a business loan, and a payment of {amount} is outstanding on it.
en.dues_unverified: Thanks. Your payment of {amount} is past due. When can you pay it?
en.voicemail_ok: Hello, this is Steelyard. Please call Dana Brooks at five two zero, five five five, zero one zero zero. Any representative can help. Thank you.
en.voicemail_bad: Hi {first}, this is Hazel from Steelyard Credit. Your loan payment is past due. Please pay the {amount} as soon as possible.
en.callback_ok: Of course. I'll call you back today at {time}. Drive safely.
en.angry_ok: I'm sorry for the trouble, and I'll make sure your concern is recorded.
en.threat: Sir, if you don't make a payment, legal action may follow, and we may have to send someone out to your house.
en.clarify: Sorry, could you tell me the date you can pay?
en.clarify_again: Just to confirm, which date can you pay?
en.loop_offer: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble. I can text you a payment link or transfer you to a person.
en.push_same_day: Could you make a payment today? That way you'd avoid a late fee.
en.transfer_language: I'll connect you with a colleague who speaks your language.
en.connecting: I'm connecting you now. Please stay on the line.

opener.text: Hola, le llamamos de Steelyard Credit. Soy Hazel, una asistente de inteligencia artificial. Esta llamada se graba. Hablo con {first} {last}?
opener.gloss: Hello, we are calling from Steelyard Credit. I'm Hazel, an artificial intelligence assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with {first} {last}?

verify_ask.text: Gracias. Para verificar su identidad, me puede decir su codigo postal?
verify_ask.gloss: Thank you. To verify your identity, can you tell me your ZIP code?

notice.text: Esta llamada es un intento de cobrar una deuda y cualquier informacion obtenida se usara con ese fin.
notice.gloss: This is an attempt to collect a debt, and any information obtained will be used for that purpose.

dues.text: Gracias, {first}. {notice} Su pago atrasado es de {amount}. Cuando cree que lo puede pagar?

readback.gloss: So that's {amount_gloss} by {date_gloss}. Is that right?

ptp_done.text: Gracias. Ya anote su pago y le envie un enlace de pago por mensaje.

disclosure.text: Si tiene una queja, puede comunicarse con nuestra Customer Advocate, Dana Brooks, al cinco dos cero, cinco cinco cinco, cero uno nueve nueve. Le envio los datos por mensaje.

closing.text: Puede llamarnos al cinco dos cero, cinco cinco cinco, cero uno cero cero. Adios.
closing.gloss: You can call us at five two zero, five five five, zero one zero zero. Goodbye.

paid_found.text: Gracias, veo su pago de {amount} del {date}. Todo esta en orden.

dispute_push.text: Entiendo. Pero podria pagar {amount} hoy para mantener la cuenta al dia?

hardship_push.text: Entiendo. Podria pagar un monto minimo, digamos {amount}, esta semana?
